title: Epiplexity Guided Data Selection and Generation for Out-of-Distribution Generalization
abstract: arXiv:2608.11746v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern systems are increasingly expected to transfer across tasks not specified during training. What data facilitates generalization in these new, unanticipated settings? One hypothesis is that data with more structural information could contain shared circuits and subprograms that could be recycled in a wider array of downstream settings. Epiplexity, a recently proposed measure of the structural information a compute-bounded learner can extract from data, provides a mechanism to reason about this relationship. In this paper, we show how to operationalize epiplexity as an online training signal for data selection and synthetic data generation. For selection, we fit scaling laws to the training loss curves of natural data domains to predict the expected epiplexity gain as a function of training tokens, and use this signal to adaptively determine the sampling weights over domains during training. translated_title: 基于Epiplexity引导的数据选择与生成用于分布外泛化
translated_abstract: 现代系统越来越期望能够在训练时未指定的任务间进行迁移。什么数据能促进这些新的、未预见情境下的泛化？一个假设是，具有更多结构信息的数据可能包含共享电路和子程序，这些可以在更广泛的下游设置中被重用。Epiplexity，一种最近提出的度量，用于衡量计算受限学习器能从数据中提取的结构信息，提供了推理这种关系的机制。在本文中，我们展示了如何将Epiplexity作为在线训练信号，用于数据选择和合成数据生成。对于选择，我们拟合自然数据域的训练损失曲线的缩放定律，以预测作为训练令牌函数的预期Epiplexity增益，并利用该信号在训练过程中自适应地确定各域的采样权重。对于合成数据生成，我们定义了...
tldr: 本文提出利用Epiplexity作为在线训练信号，通过拟合缩放定律预测数据域的Epiplexity增益，自适应调整采样权重，并用于指导合成数据生成，以提升模型在未预见任务上的分布外泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using Epiplexity as an online training signal, fitting scaling laws to predict Epiplexity gains across data domains for adaptive sampling weight adjustment, and guiding synthetic data generation, to enhance out-of-distribution generalization on unseen tasks.
